places/commonwealth-of-zayalomovsia.title: Commonwealth of Zayalomovsia
places/commonwealth-of-zayalomovsia.content:
Details
Official Name: Commonwealth of Zayalomovsia
Demonym: Zayalomovsian
Capital: Priovo
Official Language: Zayalomovsian
Government: Unitary parliamentary republic
Currency: Zayalomovsian Zenny
Area: 915,000 km²
Population: 11,200,000
Borders: Neuleia, Guille, Searen, Al Shumeiyatia, Tseun
Overview
The Commonwealth of Zayalomovsia is a cold northern nation of forests and snow. It is one of the few countries in the world built around collectivism rather than individual strength. Zayalomovsia does not train mages, and magical sciences aren’t part of its schooling. It relies instead on technology, engineering, and disciplined institutions. It is at war with the Kingdom of Searen.
Geography

Zayalomovsia lies in the north of the continent. Its climate is cold, with long, snowy winters.
Government
Zayalomovsia is governed through a set of state bodies rather than by individuals of great personal power. The State Defence Committee directs the armed forces and the conduct of war. Cultural affairs, including international representation, fall under the Board of Culture.
Magic and Technology
Zayalomovsia has no magical curriculum and trains no mages. The choice is cultural, and it sets the country apart from nations like Searen and Al Shumeiyatia, where individual mages dominate warfare and politics. Abroad, the country is widely seen as magically backward. Searish scholars describe Zayalomovsians as having few magically talented people and an education system that “doesn’t bother” teaching the basics.
In much of the world, whoever wields the most magical power effectively rules. Zayalomovsia’s refusal to train mages is a deliberate rejection of that order: no one person should be able to hold a nation hostage.
In place of magic, Zayalomovsia has advanced technology that foreigners envy. Military engineers have found that ordinary people can’t reach their own mana, but they can use it through sufficiently advanced technology.
The most famous example is the G.I.F.T. (Gauntlet-shaped Impermanent Field Thrower), a gauntlet that fires unstable plasma fields which detonate on contact. It is often called “Zayalomovsia’s pinnacle of military engineering” by engineers. It draws on the wielder’s personal mana and was designed for intimidation and deterrence. Only three prototypes exist, and only one is in active service.
Military
The Zayalomovsian army is known for rigorous, continuous training and for fighting as a coordinated force. Great focus is put on squad cohesion and unity among their soldiers.
The Intelligence Department’s Witness program is one of its more distinctive institutions. Witness officers are identified only by assigned numbers while on duty. Outside friendly territory, they wear gag-masks to guard against truth magic. They serve to gather intelligence but also to investigate suspects in the ranks of the military.
Economy
Zayalomovsian industry and infrastructure, especially rail and vehicle manufacturing, are among the most developed in the world.
Foreign Relations


                  
                  Spoilers for Season 1 - Chapter 35 below 
                  
                

Zayalomovsia is at war with the Kingdom of Searen. Searen held the upper hand in the war’s early years, but the tide has since turned in Zayalomovsia’s favour. A ceasefire has been extended indefinitely.
Zayalomovsia also invaded the small kingdom of Guille. Guille’s queen responded by freezing her own country rather than let it fall to the invaders.
Relations with the neutral Nexus Council are cautious but functional. Zayalomovsia takes part in the Flux Arena and has at times used it as a stage for national prestige.
With Tseun Zayalomovsia enjoys a healthy relationship of technological and economic exchange. This relationship has also connected the country to the Hehermadian Republic. The three countries now form an opposition to the once powerful Kingdom of Searen and Emirate of Al Shumeiyatia.

Details
Official Name: Emirate of Al Shumeiyatia
Demonym: Shumen

Currency: Shekel
Area: 803,000 km²
Population: 4,000,000
Borders: Searen, Zayalomovsia, Tseun, Hehermadia, Kuolamania
Overview
The Emirate of Al Shumeiyatia was once the largest country in the world by far. Its power has always rested on its noble mage families, who hold both political authority and exclusive access to magical education. In recent years, its southern regions broke away to form the Hehermadian Republic, leaving Al Shumeiyatia with a fraction of its former territory and population. Since then, it has allied itself with the Kingdom of Searen.
Geography

Most of Al Shumeiyatia today consists of desert, with savanna and grassland in the south. Its population is concentrated around the lakes and rivers of the south and southwest, including the shores of Hanewa Lake. The capital, Sarmend, lies only about 20 km from the Hehermadian border.
Government
Al Shumeiyatia is an elective monarchy. The emir is chosen from among the noble mage houses, which form the country’s ruling class.
Magic and Technology
Higher education in Al Shumeiyatia is magical education, and it is reserved for the mage families. Commoners generally receive none.
The Shumen Academia is known for upholding strict rules of magical science. Its time-manipulation curriculum, for example, teaches students only to suspend objects in time and forbids any attempt to reverse it. Its scholars are among the leading critics of the research conducted in Kepoi.
Al Shumeiyatia is also known as the inventor of gunpowder. Lacking access to magic, its commoners have long relied on firearms instead.
Military
Al Shumeiyatia’s military is built around its highly trained noble mages. Firearms are widespread among the common population, and they played a major role in the revolt that led to Hehermadia’s independence.
Economy
Al Shumeiyatia uses the Shekel, a currency still shared with Hehermadia. Its agriculture depends on the fertile land around its southern lakes and rivers. A major trade route runs from Tseun through southern Al Shumeiyatia into Hehermadia, and it remains important to all three countries despite their political differences. The tolls and trade along it are a significant source of income for the emirate.
Foreign Relations
The secession of Hehermadia followed a period in which Zayalomovsia invaded Al Shumeiyatia, an opportunity the southern regions used to revolt. Relations with Hehermadia remain tense, but the two countries are not at open war.
Al Shumeiyatia has since entered a formal alliance with the Kingdom of Searen, so any attack on the emirate would also involve Searen.

Overview
The Hehermadian Republic is a young federal republic that gained independence from the Emirate of Al Shumeiyatia after a popular revolt. Rejecting the rule of Al Shumeiyatia’s mage nobility, its new leadership has embraced technology over personal magic, modelling its approach on Neuleia. Hehermadia is the largest country in the world by area, but much of it is sparsely populated, creating a clear divide between its developed north and its remote rural regions.
Geography

Hehermadia covers the entire southern continent from east to west. Its landscape consists mostly of forests and grassland. The climate is mild, growing colder towards the south.
Most of the population lives in the north, where the capital, Almaszentvad, and the country’s major cities are located. The north also borders Hanewa Lake and Tokely Lake. The rest of the country consists of vast, sparsely populated areas and many remote communities.
Government
Hehermadia is a federal parliamentary republic. Its government is still young and has faced considerable internal disagreement as the country works out how it should be run, with a shared determination not to repeat the oppression of Shumen rule.
Magic and Technology
The Hehermadian government has been removing most advanced magic from school curricula and teaching science separately from magic. Magic is permitted only for professional use. Drawing sigils in public without a permit is illegal and results in prompt detention by the police. Permits are issued for professions that require magic, such as medicine and construction.
Military
Hehermadia maintains a standing army of trained soldiers. Its military makes limited use of personal magic compared to other countries, and its doctrine is much closer to that of Zayalomovsia.
Economy
Hehermadia uses the Shekel, a currency it shares with Al Shumeiyatia. The vast majority of Hehermadians work in agriculture, herding and other rural trades. The northern cities, by contrast, are modern and densely populated, and Hehermadian entrepreneurs are known for starting new ventures both at home and abroad, much like Kuolamanians.
A major trade route runs from Tseun through southern Al Shumeiyatia into Hehermadia. Hehermadia also continues the long-standing trade relationship with Kuolamania that predates its independence.
Foreign Relations
Hehermadia’s independence followed a Zayalomovsian invasion of Al Shumeiyatia, which gave the southern regions the opportunity to revolt. Relations with Al Shumeiyatia remain tense, but the two countries are not at open war.
Hehermadia has good relations with Tseun, through which it has become connected to Zayalomovsia. Together, the three countries form an opposition to Al Shumeiyatia and the Kingdom of Searen. Unlike Al Shumeiyatia, however, Hehermadia has no formal defence alliance.
Relations with Neuleia are respectful, and the republic has served as a model for Hehermadia’s development, but Hehermadia’s ties to Zayalomovsia prevent a closer relationship.

places/kingdom-of-searen.title: Kingdom of Searen
places/kingdom-of-searen.content:
Flag

Details
Official Name: Kingdom of Searen
Demonym: Searish
Capital: Akros
Official Language: Searish
Government: Feudal monarchy
Currency: Searish Crown
Area: 503,000 km²
Population: 3,800,000
Borders: Zayalomovsia, Al Shumeiyatia, Kuolamania, Nexus, Neuleia, Guille
Overview
The Kingdom of Searen is a landlocked monarchy and, for centuries, the world’s foremost magical power. Its royal family and court are made up of trained mages, and its academies are among the most prestigious in the world. Searen has rarely sought to expand its borders. It has instead spread its religion, education, calendar and sciences far beyond them. The independence of the Nexus and the war with Zayalomovsia have left the kingdom in its weakest position in centuries.
Geography

A large mountain range runs through the centre of Searen, enclosing the Guillean Kingdom in its north-eastern reaches. West of the mountains, the climate is warm, and almost the entire population lives there. Most of its major cities, including the capital Akros, are gathered around a lake of roughly 17,000 km².
East of the mountains lies a vast, arid desert with very few settlements. The border with Al Shumeiyatia runs through this desert.
Government
Searen is ruled by its royal family, every member of which is a trained mage. Official positions at court are reserved for the kingdom’s most powerful mages. The provinces are administered by their own bureaucratic institutions and owe taxes to the crown, a degree of autonomy that allowed the Nexus to break away.
Magic and Technology
Magic is the foundation of Searish society, from its government and military to its agriculture and production. Searen’s academies, such as the Lefkapon Academy of Magical Sciences, attract students from across the world. The country remains committed to magic as the basis of its power and has been slower than other nations to adapt to the rise of technology.
Military
Searen has traditionally relied on its mages for defence. In the war with Zayalomovsia, its military has withdrawn from the eastern border and evacuated several eastern cities.
Economy
Searen uses the Searish Crown. Foreign students are a major source of income, and many settle in the country after completing their studies. Widespread use of magic allows for efficient production of food and goods. Searen also receives reparations from the Nexus for its secession.
Foreign Relations


                  
                  Spoilers for Season 1 - Chapter 32 below 
                  
                

Searen has long exerted influence through culture rather than conquest, and its religion, education, calendar and sciences have spread throughout much of the world.
Searen is at war with the Commonwealth of Zayalomovsia. Searen held the upper hand in the early years, but the tide has since turned against it, and a ceasefire has been extended indefinitely. Searen has entered a formal alliance with the Emirate of Al Shumeiyatia.
The Nexus gained its independence from Searen through its monopoly on portal technology and continues to pay reparations to the crown. Searen’s most populated regions lie along its borders with Neuleia and the Nexus.

places/league-of-kuolamania.title: League of Kuolamania
places/league-of-kuolamania.content:
Flag

Details
Official Name: League of Kuolamania
Demonym: Kuolamanian
Capital: Mana
Official Language: Kuolamanian
Government: Federal merchant republic
Currency: Lira
Area: 340,000 km²
Population: 4,400,000
Borders: Neuleia, Searen, Nexus, Al Shumeiyatia, Hehermadia
Overview
The League of Kuolamania is one of the oldest countries in the world, comparable in age only to Searen. It began as an alliance of trading states that gradually merged into a single, cohesive nation. Where Searen built its power on magic, Kuolamania built its power on trade. It has long controlled the trade routes between the north and the south, and it is known for its powerful navy.
Geography

Kuolamania is a long, narrow country running along the western ocean, from Neuleia in the north to the Hehermadia in the south. No point in the country lies more than 100–200 km from the sea. Its terrain is mostly flat.
Kuolamania spans the equator, so its climate is warmest in the centre, near Searen and the Nexus, and grows cold towards both its northern and southern ends.
The capital, Mana, lies on a short but wide river connecting the western ocean to Hanewa Lake, a lake of about 85,000 km² shared with Al Shumeiyatia and Hehermadia. Ships from Mana can reach both the ocean and the lake, and traffic between the two passes through the capital.
Government
Kuolamania is a federal merchant republic. Its member states were originally trading partners, and the borders between them have largely faded over time. Political power has traditionally been concentrated among the country’s major merchant houses.
Magic and Technology
Kuolamania is not particularly advanced in either magic or technology. It has traditionally acquired what it needs through trade rather than developing it at home.
Military
Kuolamania’s strength lies in its navy, which compensates for its limited magical and technological capabilities. On land, it cannot match Searen’s mages. In its conflicts with Searen, it has instead used its control over trade, restricting the landlocked kingdom’s access to sea routes and southern goods, while avoiding open battle.
Economy
Kuolamania uses the Lira. For centuries it has held a near-monopoly on trade between the north and the south, moving goods between Neuleia and Hehermadia. Its merchants are also active lenders abroad. Kuolamania has invested heavily in the Nexus, whose portal network is set to transform cargo transport, and it seeks a role in shaping that development.
Foreign Relations
Kuolamania is often regarded by its neighbours as opportunistic, and it has a long history of border disputes. Several towns now in the Nexus were once Kuolamanian, and Kuolamania still claims part of Neuleia’s western coast, which remains Kuolamanian in culture.
Despite these tensions, it has traded with both its neighbours for centuries. It traded with Hehermadia when Hehermadia was still part of Al Shumeiyatia, and with the Neuleian states before and after they formed a republic. It is the Nexus’s most important trading partner and principal creditor.
Notable Kuolamanians

Peibhinn

places/misty-coven.title: Misty Coven
places/misty-coven.content:
The Misty Coven is a vast swampland area in the northeast of Neuleia, going into part of Zayalomovsia. The area is covered by a constant layer of mist. A coven of witches has laid claim to the area after being cast out of their homes. Several villages were lost to the coven and their leader, a will-o-wisp called Viera.
Nowadays barely anyone enters the area. Those that do either get lost or are highly-trained individuals who know how to navigate the swamplands.

places/nexus-council.title: Nexus Council
places/nexus-council.content:
Flag

Details
Official Name: Nexus Council
Demonym: Nexan
Capital: Kepoi
Official Language: Searish
Government: Unitary directorial republic
Currency: Searish Crown
Area: 22,000 km²
Population: 363,000
Borders: Searen, Kuolamania
Overview
The Nexus Council is a small country between the Kingdom of Searen and the League of Kuolamania, with its capital at Kepoi. A former region of Searen, it gained independence through its monopoly on portal technology and maintains a policy of enforced neutrality. It is home to the Flux Arena and serves as the hub of international travel.
Geography

The Nexus is flat and temperate, transitioning from savanna in the south to temperate rainforest in the north. Kepoi developed into the largest city through its connection to Searen’s main roads, while most other settlements lie along lakes, streams, and the river flowing into Kuolamania. Several northern towns were historically Kuolamanian, a legacy of past border disputes between Searen and Kuolamania.
Government
The Nexus is governed by a council built on the bureaucratic institutions inherited from Searen. To preserve its neutrality, the government is kept separate from both the Research Association and the Flux Arena Committee.
Magic and Technology
The Nexus holds a worldwide monopoly on portal technology, developed by Taika Hakopa and her research team. Despite this, it does not consider itself among the nations ruled by magical strength. Its research was shaped significantly by early Zayalomovsian and Neuleian researchers. Outside the capital, the education system still follows the magic-based Searish curriculum.
Military
The Nexus has no standing army. Its defence relies on its mages and the threat of deploying them through the portal network. Military use of the portals is prohibited.
Economy
The Nexus uses the Searish Crown. Its main sources of income are tourism, international travel, and its charter rights over portal routes, including international cargo transport. The cost of building and maintaining the portal network is shared with the countries it connects. The Nexus imports most of its raw materials, mainly from Zayalomovsia and Tseun, and relies heavily on Neuleian engineers for its infrastructure. Taxes remain high as the country finances its restructuring.
Foreign Relations


                  
                  Spoilers for Season 1 - Chapter 27 below 
                  
                

The Nexus gained independence by opening portals into every major city simultaneously and issuing an ultimatum: recognition of its independence and neutrality, a ban on military use of the portals, and a monopoly on portal technology, backed by the threat of mages striking through the portals at any time.
It continues to pay reparations to Searen for its departure. Kuolamania is its largest trading partner and creditor, and relations with Neuleia are good. Since opening its borders, the Nexus has seen considerable immigration from Kuolamania and Neuleia.

places/tseunese-triumvirate.title: Tseunese Triumvirate
places/tseunese-triumvirate.content:
Flag

Details
Official Name: Tseunese Triumvirate
Demonym: Tseunese
Capitals: Winwangy, Taisheung, Tsingshing
Official Language: Tseunese
Government: Federal directorial republic
Currency: Huizi
Area: 703,000 km²
Population: 3,800,000
Borders: Zayalomovsia, Hehermadia, Al Shumeiyatia
Overview
The Tseunese Triumvirate is an eastern country lying between Zayalomovsia to the north and Hehermadia to the south. It is governed by three heads of state, each with their own capital and area of responsibility. Tseun places great emphasis on the responsible use of magic while embracing technology, and it invented radio. It is largely isolationist. After a war with Zayalomovsia several decades ago, it shifted towards close cooperation with its former enemy.
Geography

Tseun controls a vast mountain range in the north, between Al Shumeiyatia and Zayalomovsia. Part of this range was lost to Zayalomovsia in the war. The country has an eastern coastline, from which its navy operates.
Government
Tseun is a federal directorial republic governed by three pillars, each headed by one of the three heads of state and seated in its own capital:

Winwangy: military and education, including the coordination of the army and navy.
Taisheung: agriculture, crafts and culture, and the general well-being of citizens.
Tsingshing: finance, including trade agreements, tariffs and the national bank.

The pillars operate largely independently. On matters of national importance, each head of state can veto the decisions of the others. As a result, Tseun is slow to act in foreign policy.
Magic and Technology
Magic in Tseun is taught through apprenticeship. Anyone may learn from a master, but apprentices are trained in mindfulness, ethics and their master’s philosophy alongside magic itself.
Technology is celebrated and widespread. Tseun invented and perfected radio technology, which has since been adopted even in Searen. It also developed the first television prototypes, although Zayalomovsia built the first consumer models. Tseunese cameras have recently been introduced into Hehermadia.
Military
Tseun’s military relies partly on conscription and militia, alongside its standing army and navy. Its firearms use Zayalomovsian rifling techniques, making them far superior to Hehermadian or Shumen weapons.
Economy
Tseun uses the Huizi. Its national bank and trade administration are based in Tsingshing. A major trade route runs from Tseun through southern Al Shumeiyatia into Hehermadia. Tseun maintains close technological and economic exchange with Zayalomovsia and exports raw materials to the Nexus.
Foreign Relations
Several decades ago, Tseun went to war with Zayalomovsia over the northern mountain range, following provocations on both sides. Tseun lost part of the range. Under new leadership after the war, it shifted towards cooperation with Zayalomovsia in both countries’ interest.
Tseun has good relations with Hehermadia, and together with Zayalomovsia the three countries form an opposition to Al Shumeiyatia and the Kingdom of Searen. Tseun nevertheless prefers to focus on internal matters, and its role in this alignment is largely passive.
Notable Tseunese

Su Chun
Shao Lihua

places/united-republic-of-neuleia.title: United Republic of Neuleia
places/united-republic-of-neuleia.content:
Flag

Details
Official Name: United Republic of Neuleia
Demonym: Neuleian
Capital: Ginou
Official Language: Neuleian
Government: Federal parliamentary republic
Currency: Neuleian Mark
Area: 470,000 km²
Population: 8,000,000
Borders: Zayalomovsia, Guille, Searen, Kuolamania
Overview
The United Republic of Neuleia is a federal republic formed by the unification of many small states, most of them former kingdoms and principalities. It has a long history of industrialisation and a thriving engineering sector, and it is the world’s leading centre of culture: much of the world’s best-known fashion, art, literature and performance comes from Neuleia. Magic is commonplace, but it is used mainly for convenience and artistry rather than as a source of power.
Geography

Neuleia stretches from the central mountain range in the south, bordering Searen and Guille, to the coast in the north. Much of the country lies at higher elevations, descending towards the coast. The north is cold much like its neighbour Zayalomovsia. The country borders Kuolamania to the west and Zayalomovsia to the east.
A largely uninhabited stretch of mountains separates Neuleia from Guille, which is why Guille, the most remote of the Neuleian states, never joined the republic.
The Misty Coven, a long region in the north-east, has been taken over by witches and forms a no-man’s-land between Neuleia and Zayalomovsia. Very few who enter it return. Local guides occasionally lead travellers through the region, a practice both Neuleian and Zayalomovsian authorities try to suppress.
Government
Neuleia is governed by a parliament of representatives elected by the people of its member states. The states retain considerable self-government. Many of the former ruling houses still hold their titles, though without political power.
Magic and Technology
Personal magic is widespread in Neuleia, but it is used mainly for everyday convenience and artistic expression. Neuleian education places less emphasis on advanced magical disciplines than Searen’s academies. Neuleia’s strength lies in industry and engineering, and its engineers are in demand abroad, particularly in the Nexus.
Military
Neuleia maintains a standing army that combines conventional soldiers with mage squads. Its mages are generally less powerful than those of Searen or Al Shumeiyatia, but its forces are known for their discipline and coordinated formations.
Economy
Neuleia uses the Neuleian Mark. Its economy rests on industry, engineering and an extensive cultural sector. Cities like Vante and Savey are known for their theatres and performance venues. Its northern ports handle much of its foreign trade.
Foreign Relations


                  
                  Spoilers for Season 1 - Chapter 35 below 
                  
                

Following the fall of Guille, the last remaining independent Neuleian states joined the republic.
Neuleia is an ally of Searen. The two countries compete culturally, but their strengths lie in different sectors.
Relations with Zayalomovsia are strained, but the two countries have a long history of trade and continue to exchange resources. Neuleia holds some respect for the Hehermadian Republic, but Hehermadia’s ties to Zayalomovsia prevent closer relations.
Relations with Kuolamania are now cordial, although Kuolamania maintains a claim to part of Neuleia’s western coast. Neuleia is the Nexus’s principal source of engineers. Beyond its neighbours, Neuleia generally remains neutral.
